newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QNI production lifts as weather improves.
newsitem.headline: QNI production lifts as weather improves.

text.p: Queensland-based nickel producer QNI Ltd said on Thursday nickel and cobalt production rose steadily through the June quarter as the poor weather which affected the previous quarter's results improved.
Nickel production fell 8.9 percent in the March quarter due to unusually heavy seasonal rains in Queensland state and a tropical cyclone.

"Production of nickel and cobalt at the Yabulu refinery steadily increased during the June quarter as availability of ore improved and the wet weather of the previous quarter abated," QNI said in a statement.
While the moisture content of ore remained relatively high because of steady rain at mine sites, the amount of ore treated improved significantly, partly due to restored ore stockpile levels.
Cobalt production increased 50 percent on the previous quarter and nickel recoveries were also up.
